item.description:
0.1.3

Nothing in the app looks different. This release carries a round of security work that runs underneath it, and it is the first build in which each of these is actually in force rather than written down.

  • Models are pinned and checked. Every Demucs checkpoint is verified against a full SHA-256 rather than the short prefix in its filename, and each Whisper size installs a fixed revision instead of whatever the model hub pointed at that day. A file that does not match is refused, and the voice converter is re-checked before it is loaded rather than only when it was downloaded.
  • Stem paths in a project are treated as claims. A saved project that names a file outside its own folder no longer resolves to that file.
  • The audio writer changed. Every stem, sample, karaoke bed and voice render is written through libsndfile and stays 32-bit float. Output is byte-for-byte identical to before; what is new is that the format is now stated rather than inherited.
  • The optional voice-conversion installer is locked. It installs 158 exact package versions, each checked against a published hash, instead of resolving fresh versions on the day you run it.
  • The app asks the system for less. Two of the three sandbox exceptions the engine was granted turned out to be unnecessary when measured, and are gone.
  • Updates verify the announcement, not just the download. The update feed itself is now signed, so this copy checks who wrote the update notice as well as the file it points to.

The subscription and activation path is unchanged. Nothing about your licence, your projects or your installed models needs any action.
